from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,sys
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sg=json.loads((out/'source_gate.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert sg['all_actual_calendar_dates_present'] and sg['release_count']==208 and not sg['failures']
assert not (out/'model_registration.json').exists() and not (out/'run_started.json').exists()
assert sha(root/sg['series_path'])==sg['series_sha256']
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'research'))
import multidim_money_surprise_score_v1 as model
assert model.TREE==protocol['tree'] and model.BASE==protocol['features_control'][:8]
paths=['reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1/protocol.json',
 'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1/source_calendar_freeze.json',
 'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1/source_gate.json',sg['series_path'],
 'reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/daily_inputs_corrected_20240808.parquet',
 'config/510300_financing_source_correction_20240808_v1.json',
 'research/multidim_nonlinear_score_v1.py','research/multidim_money_surprise_score_v1.py','data/reference/510300_dividends.csv']
registration={'registered_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
 'phase':'SOURCE_GATE_PASSED_BEFORE_NEW_EQUITY_SAMPLE_OR_FITS','source_gate_status':sg['status'],
 'input_hashes':{rel:sha(root/rel) for rel in paths},
 'daily_input':paths[4],'source_series':sg['series_path'],
 'decision_clock':'实际公开日上界后第一个中国交易日16:00完整状态；下一交易日09:30入场，第六个之后交易日09:30退出，共五持有间隔。',
 'duplicate_rule':'同一中国state_idx保留全部覆盖记录，但只以最后实际公布的一行供预测/训练，避免重复价格标签。',
 'calendar_month':'实际美国公布日期月份，不是观察周或中国决定日期月份。',
 'main_era_definition':'中国decision_at在2024—2025年；2022—2023仅较早背景，不选择子期营救。',
 'common_features_control':protocol['features_control'],'features_joint':protocol['features_joint'],
 'training':protocol['training'],'tree':protocol['tree'],'ridge_alpha':protocol['ridge_alpha'],
 'label_implementation':'原corrected每日net_label；按10000份，入场idx+1、退出idx+6及原4bp最低5元/10bp滑点/tick0.001/登记权益复算，不改标签。',
 'score_line':80,'positive_prediction_required':True,'parameter_searches':0,'families_fitted':3,
 'historical_source_first_vintage_verified':False,'independent_validation':False,
 'new_repository_code_edits':0,'new_accounts_before_gate':0,'orders_authorized':False,'goal_achieved':False}
(out/'model_registration.json').write_text(json.dumps(registration,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in registration.items() if k!='input_hashes'},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
